products.title: PDRN Collagen Eye Patch
products.body_html:
Refresh tired-looking under-eyes with the Drynimo PDRN Collagen Eye Patch, a targeted skincare treatment designed to hydrate, smooth and soften the visible appearance of dryness, fine lines and puffiness around the delicate eye area.

These easy-to-use under-eye patches deliver concentrated moisture exactly where skin often looks tired first. The cooling, cushion-like patches fit comfortably beneath the eyes and help create a fresher, smoother and more rested-looking appearance in just one simple step.

Targeted Care for Tired-Looking Eyes

The under-eye area is naturally thinner and more delicate than the rest of the face. Dryness, lack of sleep, stress and makeup can make fine lines, creasing and shadows appear more noticeable.

Drynimo PDRN Collagen Eye Patches are designed to give this area an instant hydration boost while supporting a softer, smoother-looking finish.

  • Helps hydrate dry and tired-looking under-eyes
  • Softens the visible appearance of fine lines and dry creases
  • Helps reduce the look of temporary puffiness
  • Supports a smoother, fresher and more rested appearance
  • Helps prepare the under-eye area for smoother makeup application
  • Easy to use as part of a morning, evening or pre-event routine

Why Choose PDRN Collagen Eye Patches?

Unlike a traditional eye cream that can spread beyond the target area, hydrogel eye patches stay positioned beneath the eyes while the formula sits closely against the skin.

This makes them an easy choice when you want concentrated under-eye hydration without adding another complicated step to your routine.

The portable patch format is ideal for:

  • Morning under-eye care
  • Evening relaxation routines
  • Preparing the skin before makeup
  • Travel and on-the-go skincare
  • Special events, photos and video calls

Key Ingredients

PDRN: Included as part of the formula’s skin-conditioning complex to support a healthier, fresher-looking appearance.

Collagen: Helps support a smoother, more hydrated and cushioned-looking finish around the under-eye area.

Hyaluronic Acid: Helps attract and retain moisture, making dry-looking lines appear softer and less noticeable.

Caffeine: Commonly used in under-eye skincare to help refresh the appearance of tired and puffy-looking eyes.

Vitamin E: Helps condition and nourish delicate-looking skin.

How to Use

  1. Begin with clean, dry skin.
  2. Use the included spatula to remove one patch for each eye.
  3. Place the patches beneath the eyes and adjust them until comfortable.
  4. Leave on for approximately 10–20 minutes.
  5. Remove the patches and gently tap any remaining essence into the skin.

Do not rinse after use. Follow with your preferred moisturizer or facial balm.

Complete Your PDRN Routine

For a more complete targeted routine, use the PDRN Collagen Eye Patch first, then follow with the Drynimo PDRN Collagen Volume Multi Balm Stick.

The eye patches deliver concentrated under-eye hydration, while the balm stick makes it easy to maintain a smoother-looking finish throughout the day on areas such as the under-eyes, smile lines, cheeks, lips and neck.

Suggested routine:

  • Step 1: Apply the PDRN Collagen Eye Patches for 10–20 minutes.
  • Step 2: Remove and gently tap in the remaining essence.
  • Step 3: Swipe the PDRN Collagen Volume Multi Balm Stick lightly over dry or creased areas.
  • Step 4: Finish with sunscreen during the daytime.

Who Is It For?

These eye patches are ideal for adults who are concerned about:

  • Tired-looking under-eyes
  • Visible dryness and fine lines
  • Temporary puffiness
  • Under-eye makeup creasing
  • Dull or dehydrated-looking skin
  • Maintaining a simple, low-effort skincare routine

Frequently Asked Questions

How often can I use the eye patches?

They can be used several times per week or whenever the under-eye area needs extra hydration and refreshment.

Can I use them before makeup?

Yes. Use the patches before applying makeup, then allow any remaining essence to absorb fully. This can help create a smoother-looking base for concealer.

How long should I leave them on?

Leave the patches on for approximately 10–20 minutes. Avoid leaving them on until they become completely dry.

Can I use them with the PDRN Collagen Volume Multi Balm Stick?

Yes. The products are designed to complement each other. Use the eye patches first, then apply the balm stick lightly to dry or creased areas.

Are they suitable for all skin types?

They are designed for a wide range of skin types. If your skin is particularly sensitive, perform a patch test before first use.

Can they permanently remove dark circles or under-eye hollows?

No topical eye patch can permanently change facial structure. These patches are designed to hydrate and improve the visible appearance of tiredness, dryness, puffiness and fine lines.

products.title: Authentic African Black Soap
products.body_html:
Authentic Raw African Black Soap From Ghana

Drynimo Authentic African Black Soap is a raw and unrefined face and body cleanser traditionally made in Ghana. Its plant-ash-based formula combines shea butter, coconut oil, palm oil and cocoa pod ash to create a rich lather that washes away dirt, sweat, excess oil and daily buildup.

Unlike commercial soaps colored to look perfectly black, authentic raw African black soap is naturally brown, textured and slightly different from bar to bar. These variations are completely normal and reflect the natural character of the formula.

Made without added fragrance, artificial dyes or preservatives, this deep-cleansing African black soap is especially suited to routines for oily, combination and blemish-prone skin. Regular cleansing helps support clearer-, smoother- and more even-looking skin while leaving the face and body feeling thoroughly clean and refreshed.

Use it alone or pair it with the Drynimo African Net Sponge for a rich lather, effective body exfoliation and a more complete shower routine.

Benefits

  • Authentic raw African black soap made in Ghana

  • Deep-cleans dirt, excess oil and everyday buildup

  • Supports clearer-, smoother- and more even-looking skin

  • Suitable for cleansing the face and body

  • Raw and unrefined with a naturally unique texture

  • No added fragrance, artificial dyes or preservatives

  • Pairs perfectly with the African Net Sponge

How to Use

Wet the soap and create a lather between your hands. Apply the lather to wet skin, massage gently and rinse thoroughly. For facial use, apply only the lather and do not rub the raw bar directly onto your face. Avoid contact with the eyes and follow with a moisturizer.

Keep the bar dry between uses and store it on a self-draining soap dish.

Ingredients: Shea Butter, Coconut Oil, Palm Oil and Cocoa Pod Ash
Weight: 100 g / 3.5 oz
Origin: Ghana
